findings.text: src/ReplicatedStorage/Client/UI/WindowNavigator.luau still hides a failed cleanup when the same close transition also errors: _close returns CloseFailed whenever state == "Error" even if _removeTop returned clean == false, and _replace likewise returns CloseFailed when closeState == "Error" and oldClean == false as long as candidate cleanup succeeds. TS-REQ-017 requires CleanupFailed whenever any cleanup/destroy/release step fails, so these reachable combined-failure branches expose the wrong public result and the current tests do not exercise them. Prioritize CleanupFailed whenever clean/oldClean is false and add deterministic coverage for close-error plus removed-window cleanup-error in both direct close and replacement recovery.
